image_description: A vintage-style illustration or photograph of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) viewed from a high-angle dorsal perspective. The crab features a broad, oval-shaped carapace with a distinct purplish-pink to reddish-brown coloration and lighter mottling. Two large chelipeds (claws) are visible at the front, along with multiple walking legs extending laterally. The background is a plain, textured beige surface resembling old paper, with faint, illegible text in the upper right corner.
